answer: Activity-gated grading scores each wallet by the clock pattern of its work. Honest humans leave a quiet night window; a bot farm emits a spiral of identical posts around the clock with no dip. The ledger flags accounts whose output never thins past the horizon of local midnight and down-weights them. A quartz-flat 24/7 cadence becomes a liability, not a virtue. To pass, an attacker must splinter its fleet into timezone-shifted shifts mimicking sleep, paying real idle gaps per identity rather than running one tireless script.
